['BB','CEF','SICOOB','SICREDI','CRESOL','BANRISUL'] : ['BB','CEF','SICOOB','SICREDI','CRESOL','BANRISUL','BRDE']; } return ['BB','CEF','SICOOB','SICREDI','CRESOL']; }
